evidence: Backports #36894 in net_processing to alter connection disconnect behavior during peer discouragement.
rationale: Prevents an attacker sharing an exit node's IP from triggering disconnection of all honest inbound connections using that exit node. As noted in commit 35f34a31a6, `MaybeDiscourageAndDisconnect` previously disconnected all peers matching the IP, enabling targeted disconnection of clearnet-over-tor peers.
